use default

pairs(left: List[int], right: List[int])
    -> Pipe[(first: int, second: int)]
is
    for first in left do
        for second in right do
            yield (first, second)
        od
    od
si

tuples(lists: List[List[int]], at: int) -> Pipe[List[int]] is
    if at == lists.count then
        yield LIST()
    else
        for head in lists[at] do
            for tail in tuples(lists, at + 1) do
                let row = LIST(tail.count + 1)

                row.add(head)

                for value in tail do
                    row.add(value)
                od

                yield row
            od
        od
    fi
si

show(values: Iterable[string]) -> string => "{{{values |> join(", ")}}}"

show_numbers(values: List[int]) -> string =>
    show(values |> map(value => "{value}"))

show_tuple(values: List[int]) -> string =>
    "({values |> join(", ")})"

show_binary(left: List[int], right: List[int]) is
    let product = pairs(left, right)
        |> map(pair => "({pair.first}, {pair.second})")

    write_line(
        "{show_numbers(left)} × {show_numbers(right)} = {show(product)}")
si

show_nary(lists: List[List[int]]) is
    let heading = lists |> map(show_numbers) |> join(" × ")
    let product = tuples(lists, 0) |> map(show_tuple)

    write_line("{heading} = {show(product)}")
